rule_level_problems.problem: Not from the red box; derived from the flowchart. Jaundice and acute illness branches are not encoded, and the rule is redundant with neck stiffness in the danger-sign rule.
Gate on HIV infection is a proxy for 'starting ART'; any HIV patient with e.g. tachycardia becomes Urgent regardless of ART context. Acceptable but over-general.

summary: All eleven red-box elements are encoded with sound SNOMED concepts and thresholds; the only red-box gap is the unquantifiable haemoptysis volume, which over-triggers. The main outside-box inconsistency is Fever being in the possible-TB rule but not the TB check_for list; jaundice/pneumonia/PJP from the flowchart and lab-dependent branches (CD4, CrAg) are not encoded.
